subject: maths
question: A cylindrical metallic rod of diameter 2 cm and length 45 cm is melted and converted into wire of uniform thickness and length 5 m. The diameter of the wire is:
solution:
Given:

Diameter = 2cm

Length = 45 cm

Formula:

Volume of cylindrical rod = πr2h

Calculation:

Radius of rod = 2/2 = 1cm = 10 mm

Length of rod = height of rod = 45cm = 450 mm

Length of wire = height of wire = 5 m = 5000 mm

Volume of rod = π × 102 × 450 = 45000π mm3

Volume of rod = Volume of wire

Volume of wire = 45000π = π × r2 × 5000

⇒ r2 = 9

⇒ r = 3 mm

∴ Thickness of wire = diameter of wire = 2r = 6 mm

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
